purpose: Restate something with a precise equivalent or definition.
keywords: Statement / term + すなわち + equivalent
I ordered one dozen, that is, twelve.
Today is the spring equinox holiday, namely a public holiday.
My mother’s older sister, in other words my aunt, is coming.
formation: Statement / term + すなわち + equivalent
restrictions: The restatement should identify essentially the same thing.
mistake: For a loose conclusion or simplification, つまり is usually more natural.
